title: Add ordered landing queue with rebase onto latest main to the drain
summary: Retry of job 20261030-013555-f5qm (A6, D145), cut to its first half: one ordered landing queue where each verified candidate is rebased onto the latest main and lands if clean, with a candidate that does not rebase cleanly held back rather than landed. The conflict return to the producer (send_back/drop_landed) and the section-6 thrash stop are named as follow-up requests. With max_in_flight = 1 drain behaves as today.

defaults_applied.how: New tests plus cargo test and clippy criteria.
Behavior criteria exercise the drain entry point.
Scope cut to queue plus rebase; the rest deferred.
Criteria check landing order and conflict outcome, not wiring.
Design doc and CHANGELOG written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Previous job 20261030-013555-f5qm failed in planning round 3 with no candidate, so no files changed and none of its work is kept; this retry starts from the base. Its findings are addressed as follows: (1) [parallel] max_concurrency > 1 finding: fixed by reading how drain_concurrent lands later group jobs today and pinning that behaviour with a test; (2) old-job state after drop_landed finding: no longer applies, because send_back/drop_landed is deferred to a follow-up; (3) Rebase to Rebased mapping finding: fixed by a small pure function in drain.rs with a unit test per arm; (4) thrash/tried finding: no longer applies, thrash stop is the follow-up; (5) size finding: fixed by the split.
Goal and audience: the maintainer running `athena drain` gets verified jobs landing one at a time onto the current main, in queue order; judged by cargo test.

Code survey: read/to read crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (Drain::land, landing mutex, drain_concurrent, attempts), crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (the [parallel] max_concurrency wiring), crates/athena-core/src/gh/landing.rs (landed_commit_for, plan_rebase) and crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs; the entry point is the drain run function exercised by the tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. No new record or data file is added under crates/, so no AnyRecord or check_record_file change is needed. The rebase result is measured directly from the resulting git history in a temporary repository.
The producer must write the answer for today's max_concurrency > 1 landing (does a later group job land today) into a code comment or the design doc with file and line, and keep that behaviour.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a drain test through the real entry point with several verified candidates shows them land one at a time in queue order, each rebased onto the main left by the previous landing (git log of the test repository shows linear order).
Run cargo test: a test shows a candidate whose rebase conflicts is not landed, main is unchanged by it, and the next candidate in the queue still lands.
Run cargo test: a test through drain_concurrent with max_concurrency 2 pins the behaviour of landing the second job of a group, matching what the code does today.
Run cargo test: unit tests cover each arm of the pure Rebase to Rebased mapping in drain.rs (clean, unchecked lands with one warning line, needs-recheck blocked, error blocked).
Run cargo test: with max_in_flight = 1 the drain tests that existed before pass; git diff shows no removed or altered existing test assertions.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry naming the ordered landing queue and rebase onto the latest main, and docs/design/async-drain.md notes that conflict return and the thrash stop are follow-up jobs.

out_of_scope: Conflict return to the producer (send_back, drop_landed, Athena::ask) and old-job record handling: follow-up request A6b
Section-6 thrash stop for repeated conflicts and the tried-set handling: follow-up request A6b
Raising max_in_flight above 1 or running several producers at once (build job 10)
Disk guard, check slots and read-ahead
Changes to crates/athena-core/src/state.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/ and crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs
departures: Median wall time held under the 2400s verifier timeout by narrowing scope; slightly lower pass probability because the landing path is hard and the earlier attempt never produced code.
urgent_reason: Cuts the planning-round failures of job 20261030-013555-f5qm: the scope is halved so one producer run fits and the two major findings (parallel max_concurrency path, old-job state) are settled or deferred.
hard_reason: Changes how the drain lands verified candidates, which is the landing path and run pipeline, so a mistake is costly.
